title: Mediterranean Chicken Pilaf
description: A flavorful and aromatic one-pot dish combining the rich flavors of the Mediterranean region with the simplicity of a chicken pilaf.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet or Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken breast and cook until browned on both sides and cooked through, about 5-6 minutes per side.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the eggplant to the skillet and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the pilaf seasoning and stir to combine.
Add the unique rice blend to the skillet and stir to combine with the eggplant mixture.
Add 2 cups of water to the skillet and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 18-20 minutes, or until the rice is tender and the liquid has been absorbed.
Return the chicken to the skillet and stir to combine with the rice mixture.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley.
